configuration.question: Does bounded additional learning resolve low visual prediction variance, and how does planning-to-predictor coupling affect equally supervised mixed heads?
configuration.continuation_contract: Restore old model and AdamW state and verify old first200 sampler prefix and initial weights. No scheduler existed. Old RNG snapshots are absent: call this optimizer-state continuation, NOT verified bitwise exact resume. New checkpoints save RNG states.
decision_rules: Complete registered fixed amounts unless nonfinite values, integrity failure, time cap, or new occupancy conflict; no early winner selection.
A three seeds only measures A variability. E-F uses paired29/11. Single-seed extended A-E is exploratory, not a robust effect claim.
Report per-horizon persistence/train-mean and C/E/F variance. Do not label target collapse or useful temporal prediction solely from variance or cosine.

Do not eliminate visual targets at 200 updates. If still worse than persistence after1000, report limitation; residual or delta-target ablation needs a separate bounded preregistration and is not automatic.
No learned selector, dynamic budget/horizon, probabilistic predictor, new full cache, encoder training, or SafeDrive retraining.
